name: the page-wide resize ignores the reserved art width
why: Without it the CAA column keeps the header's width and a summary line that arrives later is wider than its column (debug/CAA-wrapped.png).

edits.find:
Lib.debug('resize', `Table ${tableIndex}, Column ${colIndex}: ${columnWidths[colIndex]}px → ${w}px for the art summary line`);
                    columnWidths[colIndex] = w;
edits.replace: Lib.debug('resize', `Table ${tableIndex}, Column ${colIndex}: ${columnWidths[colIndex]}px → ${w}px for the art summary line`);

name: the per-sub-table resize ignores the reserved art width
why: The sub-table button measures on its own path; without the same floor its CAA column is as narrow as before.

edits.find:
Lib.debug('resize', `Sub-table "${categoryName}", Column ${colIndex}: ${columnWidths[colIndex]}px → ${w}px for the art summary line`);
                    columnWidths[colIndex] = w;
edits.replace: Lib.debug('resize', `Sub-table "${categoryName}", Column ${colIndex}: ${columnWidths[colIndex]}px → ${w}px for the art summary line`);

name: no sample is built
why: Without a sample there is nothing to reserve: both resize paths fall back to the header's width.

name: the sample has no type chips
why: The chips are most of the line; a sample without them reserves too little.

name: the measured samples stay in the page
why: The host div is appended to the body for one layout read; left there, every page carries a hidden art list per art column outside any table.
